It is informed by learned counsel for the respondents that the award in the instant case was passed in the year 2009 well before around five years from the date of coming into force of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text: Therefore, the provisions of Section 24 of the Act are not attracted to the case at hand.
